author: Goode & Bean, 1885

note.en: A western Atlantic soft-headed grenadier of the slope; only a regional record.
note.es: Un granadero de cabeza blanda del Atlántico occidental, de la pendiente; solo un registro regional.

evidence: FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic, with no local sighting reports found
recWhy: Deep-slope fish with only a FishBase listing for Costa Rica.

marks.en: Grey-brown grenadier with a large soft head, big eyes and a body tapering to a long thin tail.
marks.es: Pez granadero gris pardo con cabeza grande y blanda, ojos grandes y cuerpo que se afina hasta una cola larga y fina.
